edits.value_json: "cmd_ready is forced low whenever rst_n=0. On the first rising clk edge with rst_n=1, if FSM state is IDLE then cmd_ready shall be high in that same cycle and a held cmd_valid/cmd_payload may transfer on that edge (ready&&valid)."
edits.reason: Resolves reset-release acceptance ambiguity by defining first-cycle post-reset ready and handshake legality.

edits.value_json: "single FSM controlling phase progression IDLE->LOAD_A->LOAD_B->LOAD_BIAS->COMPUTE->OUTPUT->DONE->IDLE; DONE is exactly one cycle"
edits.reason: Makes DONE duration explicit per reviewer request.

edits.value_json: "advance only when phase transfer/count complete; compute advances per cycle by counters i,j,k; DONE lasts exactly one cycle, with all input ready outputs low during DONE, and transition to IDLE occurs on the next cycle where cmd_ready may reassert"
edits.reason: Defines readiness behavior during DONE and exact reassertion point for cmd_ready.

edits.value_json: "one-cycle pulse in DONE state immediately after the cycle of final output transfer handshake"
edits.reason: Aligns completion timing wording with explicit one-cycle DONE semantics.
